instruction: Prepare this week's HX-310 drawing change report for me. List the HX-310 documents, read the five newest, and summarize for each what changed and which action items are open.
finalAnswer:
## HX-310 weekly drawing change report

I listed the HX-310 drawing documents and read the five newest, ordered by the listed update dates. The list contains 20 drawings; all are marked **CONFIDENTIAL**.

| Updated | Document / revision | Changes reported | Open action items |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sep 30 | **HX-310 tube sheet drawing revision C with review note** (rev. 1) | Review note says tube-hole pitch changed from 23.8 mm to 25.4 mm to match the new baffle plate; gasket-face flatness tolerance tightened from 0.25 mm to 0.15 mm; material callout now references approved supplier list rev. 12. | Update tie-rod positions on the assembly drawing (design team); confirm drilling sequence with supplier before first article (quality). |
| Sep 28 | **Expansion joint detail drawing** (rev. E) | Drawing says changes are tracked in the engineering change notice log; no specific changes are included in the document text. | Not stated in the document. |
| Sep 28 | **Shell flange detail drawing** (rev. C) | Drawing says changes are tracked in the engineering change notice log; no specific changes are included in the document text. | Not stated in the document. |
| Sep 27 | **Tube sheet detail drawing** (rev. D) | No revision changes described; document notes that critical-to-quality characteristics are marked on sheet one. | Not stated in the document. |
| Sep 26 | **Shell flange assembly drawing** (rev. E) | Material callouts reference the approved supplier list; no specific revision changes described. | Not stated in the document. |

For the two detail drawings whose change history points to the engineering change notice log, the documents themselves don’t provide the change details.
